note: Item codes are the .sav column names, unchanged by data/ecuador_2011_safety.do (Table 10 victim, local survey_cols I71A I72A). The .sav variable labels tie each code to the form question: I71A = "I71A. Fué víctima de un delito entre 2006 y el 2010" (q.7.1), I72A = "I72A. Fué víctima de un delito entre 2010 y el 2011" (q.7.2), 2/2. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.8 (section VII. VÍCTIMA DE DELITOS, q.7.1 and q.7.2), checked against the rendered page image, not the terse .sav labels; item_text is each question's full stem, line break joined; the interviewer line MARQUE UN SOLO CÓDIGO and the follow-ups (7.1 ¿De cuántos?, 7.2 ¿Cuántas veces? = I71B/I72B, not in this table; 7.2 No -> PASE A 7.4) are not shipped; no shared instructions (the two stems differ in reference period, so each carries its own). Options: the form prints Si 1 / No 2 (Si without accent, as printed; no No sabe/No responde codes for these questions); the .sav value labels read Si=1 / No=2. The do-file recodes Si->1, No->0, so IRW resp 0 = No, which is form code 2 (recode, not a form code). Route 9 by server-side GROUP BY (no export): live item x resp counts equal .sav counts in 4/4 cells (I71A Si/No 32741/84996; I72A 22188/95549).
